title: Chapter 639 - 639 With Lin Fan As The Master; Xia Xue Does A Live Broadcast Again!
content:
Chapter 639 - 639 With Lin Fan As The Master; Xia Xue Does A Live Broadcast Again!

Chapter 639 - 639 With Lin Fan as the Master; Xia Xue Does a Live Broadcast Again!

639 With Lin Fan as the Master; Xia Xue Does a Live Broadcast Again!

In the Wang family’s history, Wang Fengyi was the creator of the Wang family’s glory and the one who paved the future!

He was the soul of the entire Wang family!

At this moment…

Wang Fengyi was also sizing up Wang Zhihai. He nodded slightly and said, “What era is it now?”

“Ancestor, today is August 27th, 3020,” Wang Zhihai hurriedly said.

“Year 3020. In the blink of an eye, a thousand years have passed.”

“Wang Zhihai, you have to remember this!” Wang Fengyi said solemnly. “The Imperial Hotel and the entire Wang family were able to develop to their current state because of Mr. Lin!

“Everything in the Wang family belongs to Mr. Lin. All members of the Wang family must obey Mr. Lin’s orders and serve Mr. Lin as their master!”

“Yes!” Wang Zhihai replied respectfully.

Lin Fan did not mind the Wang family’s words at all.

As for the order, he did not take it to heart.

That was because with Lin Fan’s strength and power, he could easily get whatever he wanted.

Today, the entire Wang Manor was decorated with lanterns and streamers. It was filled with joy. An incomparably luxurious banquet was held, and the atmosphere was extremely warm.

It was because Lin Fan, the head of the Wang family, and Wang Fengyi, the ancestor of the Wang family, were all present!

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

After returning from the Imperial Hotel the day before yesterday, Lin Fan’s figure kept appearing in Xia Xue’s mind for some reason.

Lin Fan’s handsome face, his strong body, every word he said, and every action he made…

As a result, Xia Xue tossed and turned all night. She was unable to sleep.

The next day, she lay in bed for an entire day before she regained some of her energy.

After Xia Xue had breakfast, she casually strolled around.

After crossing the wide road and luxurious streets, she arrived at the downtown area.

Neon lights flashed, and laughter resounded. The place was filled with the smell of fireworks.

When Xia Xue gently sniffed, she suddenly smelled a tempting fragrance.

She looked ahead and saw a warm and trendy shop not far away—Yuesse Snow Tea.

In front of the shop, there was a long line of nearly a hundred people.

Even though the queue was long, no one chose to leave.

In fact, there was even an endless stream of people coming to join the queue.

This was the charm of Yuesse Snow Tea’s unique taste!

In today’s world, many things such as food and tea could be produced by machines and androids.

However, there were also a few unique products that required manual production. Yuesse Snow Tea was one of them.

Xia Xue murmured, “How did I come here? It seems that there are quite a number of people who want to drink Yuesse Snow Tea. I’ll film myself drinking it for them.”

While talking, Xia Xue also joined the queue.

After thinking for a moment, she took out the foldable display and turned on the camera.

After a while, Xia Xue’s delicate face appeared in the live broadcast room.

The number of viewers rose rapidly, and the comments kept appearing.

Divine Weapon Descends: [Xia Xue is finally streaming again.]

Flower: [Xia Xue is still as beautiful as before!]

High Spirits: [Xia Xue, tell me who Mr. Lin is.]

Moon in Water: [Xia Xue, do you know? Dafang Group had already collapsed. Was this done by Mr. Lin’s family? Is he that strong?]

Han: [F*ck! Dafang Group collapsed?]

My Heart: [What Dafang Group? What Mr. Lin? Also, Xia Xue, how did you suddenly become so popular? Did I miss something?]

…

In fact, it was not just the audience who were surprised but Xia Xue too.

Her beautiful eyes were wide open, and her face was filled with disbelief.

She was studying at Jiangbei University, so she had naturally heard of Dafang Group.

It was a large group that focused on electronics, tourism, chemicals, culture, entertainment, and many other industries. Its market value even exceeded ten billion World Coins!

In the end, it collapsed?

In just two short days, it collapsed?

If this was really Lin Fan’s doing, then… Then what was his identity?

Suddenly, Lin Fan’s handsome figure appeared very clearly in Xia Xue’s mind. Moreover, Lin Fan’s figure was getting bigger and bigger! It bloomed with an incomparably dazzling light!

At this time, a slightly impatient voice came from behind Xia Xue.

“Those in front, hurry up and walk!”

It turned out that Xia Xue had been in a daze for too long, and there was already a big gap between her and the person in front.

Xia Xue reacted and said, “I-I’m sorry.”

She quickly took a few steps forward and said to the camera, “Welcome to Xia Xue’s live broadcast room.

“Last time, I tried the delicacies of the Imperial Hotel on behalf of everyone.

“I have to say, the Imperial Hotel is indeed a world-renowned nine-star hotel. The interior is naturally high-end and luxurious to the extreme…

“The private room on the 365th floor makes people feel like they’re in a palace in the clouds. Standing in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, you can easily take in the beautiful scenery of Jiangbei!

“As for the delicacies of the Imperial Hotel, every dish tastes excellent and distinct. The food’s so delicious that I almost bit my own tongue…”

Xia Xue could not help but swallow her saliva as she spoke.

Obviously, she was thinking about the delicious food at the Imperial Hotel again.

At this moment, a different voice sounded behind her.

“Ha! Trying the delicacies of the Imperial Hotel in a private room on the 365th floor? You make it sound like it’s real. There should be a limit to bragging.”

…

In the live broadcast room…

Deep Love: [Who’s talking?]

Wind: [How annoying.]

Da Xiong: [He was so fierce just now, and now he’s saying such things! How infuriating!]

Crescent Moon: [How rude! Besides, what does it have to do with him whether others went to eat there or not?]

Who Are You:[ I haven’t encountered this kind of person. Otherwise, I would’ve taught him a lesson!]

…

Not only was the audience unhappy, but Xia Xue was also a little unhappy.

She slowly turned around and said in a somewhat impolite tone, “I’m just talking about the Imperial Hotel. I shouldn’t have disturbed you, right?”

It was a man with a pointy mouth and ape-like cheeks. He wore a checkered shirt.

When he saw Xia Xue’s face, his already small eyes narrowed into a thin line.

The monkey-faced man chuckled. “Actually, if you really want to go to the Imperial Hotel, I can take you there.

“By the way, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Xiong Kai. My father is Xiong Anqing, the department manager of the Imperial Hotel.

“Don’t worry, it’s absolutely easy for me to bring you in. It’s not even difficult to eat inside.”

As Xiong Kai spoke, he could not help but raise his neck.

It was as if he had revealed his identity as the crown prince.

Now, he was just waiting for Xia Xue to have stars in her eyes and start to worship him.
